note: Inventoried the 24h builds (window 2026-10-02T18:41Z-2026-10-03T18:59Z): 7 commits, 217 files, 15,998 insertions, 9 build entries (route_chat front door incl its mid-window depth-flag/failover amendment, dice-law dungeon, tavern bar-fight carrier, arena gwap->GPS pipe, grok-4.7 carrier, fifty-wide wave protocol, frontier delta replay+register, STANDING_RAILS drop-in table, mag-rails plugin spec) with per-build does/replaced/cost/enables; window paid cost $23.9143 hermes_burn (858 rows: play $16.17, design asks $7.74) plus unpriced xAI 62.7K tok; the ask's 1,569-receipt figure could not be reproduced from any countable surface (recounts: 402 watch/inbox files, ~205 fleet trail rows, 858 usage rows, 72 room rows) and rides the ask unreproduced; tree moved mid-inventory (53f56d0f3) and the receipt was amended to post-amendment bytes.

rows.claim: One import replaces every tool's private urllib carrier: lane+model resolution, dormant gate, endpoint fence, key failover chain, usage banking, and a depth flag that re-scoped the deepseek thinking-off law to per-call policy after the sacred-cow probe showed thinking-on gives 2-3x complete design outputs with zero AH10 failures.
rows.quote: you have a pet model harness and never use it by default
rows.steal: Next sitting: migrate one carrier (tavern, dungeon, hermes_burn, or grok_burn) to route_chat per the STANDING_RAILS debt list; new call paths start here.
rows.falsifier: A tool landing with its own urllib/fence/key code and no written reason in its docstring, or a dormant lane executing without operator_go.

rows.claim: tools/dungeon.py enforces rolls as sha256 preimages over the chain tip committed before the actor speaks, quirks as carrier law (NOROLL dossier drift, over-claim tax, claim-before-strike), and REAL_SCROLLS turns in-game AUDITs into real byte-checks of estate claims - a game hit is a banked verification.
rows.quote: The dice decide WHO gets to try; the bytes decide WHAT IS TRUE.
rows.steal: Reuse the preimage-dice + golden-vector startup pin shape for any multi-agent run needing tamper-evident, model-unfudgeable decisions; add new REAL_SCROLLS entries to audit fresh estate claims.
rows.falsifier: A session whose verdicts cannot be recomputed from {tip}:{scene}:{turn}:{actor} preimages, or one that starts with golden vectors failing to reproduce.

rows.claim: tools/tavern.py makes multi-agent escalation measurable: a judge model scores each persona 0-5 from transcript only, brawl fires at cumulative escalation >= heat (18 - 2*pressure), and the pressure knob exists because scene-1's falsifier actually fired (no brawl at pressure 0).
rows.quote: Scene 1's falsifier fired (no brawl at pressure 0 in 10 rounds); pressure is the fix.
rows.steal: Reuse the judge-scores-transcript-only + falsifier-knob pattern for any behavioral experiment needing a tunable trigger; cost note: 15 runs cost $15.48, the day's largest line - budget judge model choice.
rows.falsifier: A scenario whose falsifier cannot fire (no observable that distinguishes working from broken at calibration defaults).

rows.claim: tools/arena_gwap.py converts any playground session into chain-verified GWAP payloads (fighter intent vs carrier report, agreement_score = confirmed-declared fraction) and feeds the GPS capability ledger fail-closed, making routing dollars follow measured play capability.
rows.quote: a model cannot claim an action the dice did not rule; the carrier cannot rule an action nobody declared
rows.steal: Reuse the adapter shape (intent vs report payloads + fail-closed scene->model map) to turn ANY multi-agent session log into routing evidence; first fix the tavern 0.0-report defect (persona report channel only fills from judge/verdict rows with no actor).
rows.falsifier: A scene_id mapped to a model by guessing, or agreement scores banked for a run whose transcript hash changed after banking.

rows.claim: Single-wave Task-agent fan-out at width 50 is clean on the paid max seat (50/50 returned, zero 429/1302, ~1.0M tok wave 1; 30 REAL/11 DRIFTING/3 FALSE/6 UNVERIFIABLE on real byte-checks wave 2, ~1.5M tok, $0), amending the width-12 practical ceiling and catching a planted forgery.
rows.quote: 50/50 agents returned their answer. ZERO surfaced 429/1302 contacts.
rows.steal: Route any N>=30 independent byte-check job through the wave-2 shape: regex-extract units, one Task agent per unit, one-line verdict contract, consensus denominator as health check, FALSE/DRIFTING become tickets.
rows.falsifier: A sustained multi-wave 50-wide cadence surfacing 429/1302s (single-wave is the only claim), or workflow children tried above max_concurrency 3.

rows.claim: The same 14 real design asks replayed across frontier/flash/deepseek arms and scored into a machine-readable register produce a capability-per-cost routing table from real work, with the estate's delta named: measured capability with chain-verified receipts, not predicted quality on static evals.
rows.quote: They route on PREDICTED quality (learned preference routers, confidence estimators). We route on MEASURED capability
rows.steal: Extend the register with the RouteLLM cascade as routing rule (ds first, flash judge gate, frontier on CHALLENGE) and force the register to name ask classes where cheap-and-good FAILS, not just where it wins.
rows.falsifier: A register built from asks that were never real production work, or arm scores not reproducible from the replay files.

rows.claim: queue/STANDING_RAILS.md turns the day's builds into a system: four rails laws (default-to-rails, material-must-render or VOID, interrupts-never-cancel, every-session-banks), a ten-row what-you-have/where-it-lands/what-comes-out table, and registered debts so migration is incremental.
rows.quote: Default to the rails. A bespoke model-call path requires a written reason in its docstring.
rows.steal: Before any next build, check the drop-in table for an existing row; the spec-before-behavior doc for new rails is this file, so new rails land as rows here first.
rows.falsifier: A new model-calling tool landing with no rails row and no written reason, or a batch output claiming ok=True without its material rendered.

rows.claim: tools/grok_burn.py gives the funded grok-4.7 rung a working carrier (3 asks fired, 58,044 tok in / 4,643 out, outputs in watch/inbox/xai_grok47/), with cost_usd honestly left null because the xAI per-token price is not banked.
rows.quote: Evidence is rendered into the prompt, outputs land under watch/inbox/xai_grok47/, usage banks to memory/runs/xai_grok/usage.jsonl
rows.steal: Reuse the ask-spec dict + evidence render + skip-if-exists shape for any funded-lane batch; fix the price gap by banking xAI per-token cost instead of null.
rows.falsifier: A funded dispatch whose usage row carries cost_usd null without a named reason, or an ask re-fired after its output file exists.

rows.claim: watch/inbox/mag_rails_plugin_spec_20261003.md specs six native ZCode tools over the standing rails (route_chat, stage_ask, arena_status, delta_register, gwap_bank, sacred_cow) so the seat calls the estate natively instead of bash+pythoning into it.
rows.quote: This is the spec of what the plugin exposes, so the seat stops bash+pythoning into the estate and calls it natively.
rows.steal: Build the plugin tools spec-first (spec landed before code per build discipline); mag_sacred_cow is the registrable form of the sacred-cow probe pattern that re-scoped the thinking-off law.
rows.falsifier: Plugin tools shipped without the spec's contract, or a sacred cow defended rather than probed when its law annexes a new task class.
